lead_raw_text:
The structure of Li8Mn4Co4O16 (reduced formula Li2MnCoO4) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Cmcm (No. 63), with 32 atoms in the unit cell across six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Co and Mn centers in tetrahedral environments of four oxygen neighbors, while Li centers show six oxygen neighbors. Corner-sharing is observed between Co- and Mn-centered tetrahedra and between Li-centered polyhedra and the Co- or Mn-centered tetrahedra, with edge-sharing also present between Li polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 32 sites.
